item.title: System of agentic AI for the discovery of metal–organic frameworks
item.content:encoded:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 20 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01058-x

An agentic AI system, MOFGen, is developed to accelerate the discovery of synthesizable metal–organic frameworks.

item.title: Predicting degradation of polymeric materials in complex chemical environments via molecular modeling
item.content:encoded:
Nature Computational Science, Published online: 20 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01041-6

This Perspective explores how physical models, in collaboration with big data and artificial intelligence, can accelerate our understanding of the degradation of soft materials.
